title: DESIGN.md in 2026: How to Describe a Design System for AI Agents
h1: DESIGN.md in 2026: How to Describe a Design System for AI Agents
tldr: DESIGN.md helps communicate a design system’s visual rules and decisions to an AI agent, but it does not replace code, tokens, or documentation. A useful format is layered, points to sources of truth, and is validated by automated tests.
